branch_reviews.rationale: runMutators sets functionConfig via pn.refreshFnConfig(mutator, input, pl.Mutators[i].ConfigPath) and then calls fnruntime.SelectInput(input, selectors, exclusions, ...) on the same unchanged input, so the configPath-designated resource is selected as ordinary input. This is the mutator branch of V1/A2. Excluding the resolved config resource from the SelectInput slice (while retaining it in the package input / final output) is the intended change.

runValidators sets functionConfig via pn.refreshFnConfig(validator, input, function.ConfigPath) and selects ordinary input from the unchanged input list with fnruntime.SelectInput, so the configPath resource is also selected as an ordinary input item. This is the validator branch of V2/A2 and is the intended second change.

runPipeline only sequences pn.runMutators(ctx, hctx, input) and then pn.runValidators(ctx, hctx, mutatedResources); it holds no configPath ordinary-input selection logic and merely forwards the mutated resource list. The repair is confined to the two owning functions, so this orchestration must stay as-is, including the error wrapping and empty-pipeline KRM check.

Renderer.Execute handles hydration ordering, save-on-render-failure, rel-path adjustment and output writing. It does not resolve ConfigPath, bind functionConfig, or perform ordinary-input selection, so it is not part of the A2/R3/R4 relation chain and needs no change for these violations.
